assets_kind_ck.name: assets_kind_ck
assets_kind_ck.value:
("assets"."kind" = 'file' AND "assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "assets"."sha256" IS NOT NULL
            AND "assets"."storage_key" LIKE 'projects/' || "assets"."project_id"::text || '/%')
       OR ("assets"."kind" = 'link' AND "assets"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "assets"."storage_key" IS NULL)

publications_dates_ck.name: publications_dates_ck
publications_dates_ck.value:
("publications"."status" <> 'scheduled' OR "publications"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL)
       AND ("publications"."status" <> 'published' OR "publications"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
